<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1479
Claimant:
William Kaiser
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2023-10-18
Claim received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped in traffic.
The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2023-12-23
Confirmed the driver of the claimed vehicle is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy period.
2023-12-29
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene, and the responding officer noted the
impact as minor, with no airbag deployment and both vehicles driven from the scene.
2024-01-23
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the claim. They show the rear bumper damage and the point of contact
consistent with the described impact. A few old scratches on the lower panel may predate this loss and will be noted
separately during the estimate review.
2024-02-03
Vehicle damage has been inspected and the repair scope matches the impact as described. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so the account rests on the parties' statements and the physical evidence.
2024-03-15
Claimant's recorded statement was taken through counsel. The account stayed consistent with the first notice of loss,
though a few small details were added on this call, such as the seating position and the moment of braking.
2024-04-08
Medical recodrs reflect a diagnosis of neck and back strain. Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for
this type of injury, and the severity of the claimed injury appears high relative to the low-speed impact. No prior injury
to the same body areas is known from the records received so far.
2024-05-17
Next steps are to request prior medical records, schedule an independent medical review, and obtain a final repair
estimate before any evaluation of the bodily injury portion is made. File remains open pending these items.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
